observation.command: cat > /tmp/full.py <<'PY' import urllib.request, urllib.parse, http.cookiejar, re, json, sys BASE="http://localhost/qisutu/install.pl" cj=http.cookiejar.CookieJar() op=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(cj), urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler()) def get(url=BASE): r=op.open(url); return r.geturl(), r.read().decode('utf-8','replace') def post(data,url=BASE): r=op.open(url, urllib.parse.urlencode(data).encode()); return r.geturl(), r.read().decode('utf-8','replace') def csrf(html): m=re.search(r'name="CSRFToken" value="([0-9a-f]+)"',html); return m.group(1) if m else None def report(tag,url,html): m=re.search(r'(.*?)',html); print(tag,"URL:",url,"TITLE:",m.group(1) if m else '?') for e in re.findall(r'qisutu-install-error[^>]*>(.*?)',html,re.S): print(" ERROR:",re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',e).strip()) return html url,html=get(); report("step1",url,html) url,html=post({"Step":"1","Action":"Begin","CSRFToken":csrf(html)}); report("begin",url,html) url,html=get(BASE+"?Step=2"); report("step2",url,html) url,html=post({"Step":"2","Action":"AcceptLicense","CSRFToken":csrf(html),"LicenseAccepted":"1"}); report("license",url,html) url,html=get(BASE+"?Step=3"); report("step3",url,html) url,html=post({"Step":"3","Action":"InstallDatabase","CSRFToken":csrf(html),"DBHost":"localhost","DBPort":"3306","DBName":"qisutu","DBUser":"qisutu","DBAdminUser":"root","DBAdminPassword":"","UseBootstrap":"1"}); report("dbinstall",url,html) if "database_done" not in json.dumps(cj._cookies): pass url,html=post({"Step":"3","Action":"ContinueAfterDatabase","CSRFToken":csrf(html)}); report("continue",url,html) url,html=get(BASE+"?Step=4"); report("step4",url,html) url,html=post({"Step":"4","Action":"SaveSystem","CSRFToken":csrf(html),"HTTPType":"http","FQDN":"localhost","WebPath":"/qisutu","AdminEmail":"admin@example.org","DefaultLanguage":"de","Timezone":"Europe/Berlin","TicketHook":"Qisutu","AttachmentMaxSize":"25"}); report("savesys",url,html) url,html=get(BASE+"?Step=5"); report("step5",url,html) url,html=post({"Step":"5","Action":"SkipMail","CSRFToken":csrf(html)}); report("skipmail",url,html) url,html=get(BASE+"?Step=6"); open('/tmp/final.html','w').write(html); report("final",url,html) PY python3 /tmp/full.py
